Getting Started with the API

This guide explains how to use our REST API.

What is an API key?

An API key is a unique identifier that authenticates your requests. You will receive an API key when you register for an account. Keep your API key confidential.

Authentication

To authenticate, include your API key in the request header. Never share your API key in public repositories or documentation.

Rate Limits

The API allows up to 1000 requests per hour per API key. If you exceed this limit, you will receive a 429 Too Many Requests response.

Error Codes

  • 401: Invalid or missing API key
  • 403: Forbidden
  • 429: Rate limit exceeded
